notes: Sign in with the generated password: marimo's login page asks for the access token, which the recipe sets with --token-password from MARIMO_PASSWORD. Without it nothing opens, including the WebSocket that runs the notebook kernel.
Notebooks are .py files in the notebooks volume (/app/data), which is the editor's home folder; create and open them from marimo's file list. They survive restarts and redeploys.

The image is marimo's official base variant (ghcr.io/marimo-team/marimo:0.25.1, Python 3.13 slim, running as the image's non-root appuser). The -data and -sql variants that preinstall pandas, numpy and altair were not published for 0.25.x. Packages a notebook installs from marimo's package panel go into the container, not the volume, so they are gone after the container is recreated; a notebook that needs them installs them again on first run.
Code in a notebook runs inside this container with the app user's rights: there is no docker.sock, no extra capability and no host mount.
marimo's update check and its sandbox prompt are off (--skip-update-check, --no-sandbox), since the container itself is the sandbox.
